_doc: The kind of land a map is (lands.gd, D.LAND): how wooded it is, and what goes with that, so the map hangs together. woods: count (forests, x the map's base 80 per standard area), trees per forest and its spread [min, max], follow (0-1: how strictly forests keep to the wet ground of a woodland noise map instead of falling anywhere), river (more woods near rivers). moisture (0 dry - 1 wet): the grass colour and its dry patches. bushes, herds: berry patches and deer, x. weather: chance multipliers per weather kind. wildfire: how fast fire spreads. Random maps pick a land by the weights in random (or the New Game choice) and vary its numbers by +-jitter, all from the map seed; scenarios name theirs (default otherwise).

steppe.name: Steppe
steppe.desc: Open grassland: a few copses by the water, big herds, dry summers and fast fires.

parkland.name: Parkland
parkland.desc: Meadows and scattered woods: a little of everything.

woodland.name: Woodland
woodland.desc: Large woods with meadows between them: timber everywhere, fewer deer, more rain.

old_forest.name: Old forest
old_forest.desc: Deep forest with a few clearings: dark, damp and full of timber, but game is scarce.
